final: SELECT AVG(step5.avg_instownpct) as avg_instownpct_final, AVG(step5.ratio) as avg_ratio_final, AVG(step5.diff) as avg_diff_final FROM (SELECT step3.transref, step3.ordertypedist, step3.avg_instownpct, step3.ratio, step3.avg_instownpct - step4.overall_avg as diff FROM (SELECT step1.transref, step1.ordertypedist, step1.avg_instownpct, CASE WHEN step2.ordertypedist_avg IS NOT NULL AND step2.ordertypedist_avg != 0 THEN step1.avg_instownpct / step2.ordertypedist_avg ELSE NULL END as ratio FROM (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) as avg_instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist) step1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_instownpct) as ordertypedist_avg FROM (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) as avg_instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist) step1_inner GROUP BY ordertypedist) step2 ON step1.ordertypedist = step2.ordertypedist) step3, (SELECT AVG(avg_instownpct) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) as avg_instownpct FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist)) step4 WHERE step3.avg_instownpct > step4.overall_avg) step5
